Résumé
I’m a Senior Data & AI Consultant with experience delivering
advanced analytics, automation, and AI solutions across the
banking, energy, and technology sectors. I’ve implemented SAS
IFRS9, SAS Viya, and Visual Analytics platforms, and developed
Gen AI powered web applications using Python, React, and GPT
APIs integrating LLM workflows, prompt engineering, and data
reasoning to enable natural language analysis and automated
reporting.
Outside of my consulting work, I’m deeply involved in independent
research on Large Language Models (LLMs) studying their core
architecture, training dynamics, and transformer internals, and
building proofs of concept to explore how these systems can reason,
adapt, and interact with structured data.
My current focus lies at the intersection of LLM interpretability,
hybrid AI architectures, and domain-specific GenAI applications.
I’m particularly interested in how transformer-based models can
be optimized, specialized, and safely integrated into enterprise
workflows.
